teaser.en: Its flowers bloom above ground, then the young pods push down into the soil to ripen in the dark.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huchanua juu ya ardhi, kisha maganda machanga hujipenyeza chini udongoni kuivia gizani.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganatuluka dzulu ya tsi, chisha makakaya matsanga ganainjira photsi ndani ya ulongo ili kuivwa gizani.

summary.en: *Njugu karanga* is the groundnut or peanut, a low legume whose pods ripen underground. On the coast the nuts are roasted, boiled or ground into sauces.
summary.sw: *Njugu karanga* ni karanga (njugu nyasa), mmea mfupi wa jamii ya kunde ambao maganda yake huivia chini ya ardhi. Pwani karanga hukaangwa, huchemshwa au husagwa kutengeneza michuzi.
summary.dg: *Njugu karanga* ni mmea wa kunde wa tsini-tsini ambao makakayage ganaivwa tsini. Pwani njugu nkuochwa, nkutsemswa au nkusagwa kuhenda mtsuzi.

about.en:
*Njugu karanga* is a low, bushy legume with leaves of four small oval leaflets and small yellow pea flowers. After flowering, the flower stalk lengthens and bends down, pushing the developing pod into the soil, where it ripens.

The pods are pale, wrinkled shells holding one to three seeds in papery red-brown skins.
about.sw:
*Njugu karanga* ni mmea mfupi wenye matawi mengi wa jamii ya kunde, wenye majani ya vijani vinne vidogo vyenye umbo la yai na maua madogo ya manjano kama ya njegere. Baada ya kuchanua, kikonyo cha ua hurefuka na kupinda chini, kikisukuma ganda linalokua ndani ya udongo, ambamo huiva.

Maganda ni makaka meupe yenye makunyanzi yanayobeba mbegu moja hadi tatu zilizofunikwa kwa maganda membamba kama karatasi ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu.
about.dg:
*Njugu karanga* ni mmea mdide wa kunde wenye panda nyinji, wenye makodza madide ga duara-ndefu ganagomera mane-mane, na maruwa madide ga rangi ya mandano dza ga kunde. Bada ya kulavya maruwa, mlita wa ruwa unakala mure na kubeduka photsi, uchisukuma kakaya rinarokula ndani ya ulongo, ambamo rinaivwa.

Makakaya ni magada ga rangi ngushu-ngushu ganagokunjamana, na ndani gana tembe mwenga hadi tahu zirizofwinikpwa ni magada membamba dza karatasi, ga rangi ya kundu na dongo.

where.en: Groundnuts are grown on sandy soils, which are loose enough for the pods to form and easy to dig at harvest.
where.sw: Karanga hulimwa kwenye udongo wa mchanga, ambao ni tifutifu kiasi cha kuruhusu maganda kujitengeneza na ni rahisi kuchimba wakati wa mavuno.
where.dg: Njugu nkurimwa kpwenye ulongo wa mtsanga, ambao ni laini chiasi cha makakaya kuweza kumera na ni rahisi kutsimba wakati wa mavuno.

uses.en:
The nuts are roasted or boiled and eaten as snacks, or ground into a paste to thicken sauces and stews.

Harvesting groundnuts has its own Digo verb, *fuka*.
uses.sw:
Karanga hukaangwa au huchemshwa na kuliwa kama vitafunio, au husagwa kuwa rojo la kuongeza uzito kwenye michuzi na mitoweo.

Kuvuna karanga kuna kitenzi chake maalum cha Kidigo, *fuka*.
uses.dg:
Njugu nkuochwa au nkutsemswa na kuriwa dza vitu vya kuafuna, au nkusagwa kuhenda uji-uji wa kuhenda mitsuzi ikale miziho.

Kuvuna njugu kuna nenore ra Chidigo, *fuka*.

names.en: Digo: *njugu karanga* in Mgombato and *njugu nyasa* in Pakia. Swahili: *karanga* or *njugu nyasa*. English: groundnut or peanut. Scientists call it *Arachis hypogaea*. The plant comes originally from South America.
names.sw: Kidigo: *njugu karanga* katika Mgombato na *njugu nyasa* katika Pakia. Kiswahili: *karanga* au *njugu nyasa*. Kiingereza: *groundnut* au *peanut*. Wanasayansi huuita *Arachis hypogaea*. Asili ya mmea huu ni Amerika Kusini.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *njugu karanga* kpwenye Mgombato na *njugu nyasa* kpwa Pakia. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *karanga* au *njugu nyasa*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *groundnut* au *peanut*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Arachis hypogaea*. Mmea hinyu asiliye ni Amerika ya Kusini.

reason.en: Bambara groundnut, which also ripens underground
reason.sw: Njugu mawe, ambazo pia huivia chini ya ardhi
Kunde, mmea mwingine wa shambani wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: *Kunde*, mmea wanjina wa jamii ya kunde wa mindani

reason.en: Sesame, another oily seed of sandy farms
reason.sw: Ufuta, mbegu nyingine yenye mafuta ya mashamba ya mchanga
reason.dg: *Ufuha*, tembe yanjina ya mafuha ya minda ya mtsanga

reason.sw: Mbaazi, nafaka nyingine ya jamii ya kunde ya pwani
reason.dg: *Mbalazi*, zao ranjina ra jamii ya kunde ra pwani

mgombato: njugu karanga (-) peanut plant (Arachis hypogaea); njugu.
